_readme: 장면 그림 출처. 그림 파일은 instagram/build/art/(git 제외)에 두고, 여기에는 다시 만들거나 내려받을 수 있게 출처만 적는다. kind: public-domain(퍼블릭 도메인 성화) | generated(로컬 오픈소스 모델, 이 맥에서 생성).

heb-13-16.prompt: In a sunlit courtyard of a simple stone house in the first-century Middle East, a woman hands a round loaf of bread and a small clay jar to an elderly neighbor at the gate while two children watch. Warm afternoon light, clay pots, a fig tree. Gentle, everyday mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

rom-12-17.prompt: A small group of ordinary men and women gathered in a lamplit room of a crowded ancient Roman apartment building at evening, one man reading aloud from a scroll letter while the others listen. Warm oil lamp light, plaster walls, a window showing tall city buildings at dusk. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

pro-10-12.prompt: By the warm light of a small clay oil lamp, an elderly woman gently draws a woolen blanket over a sleeping young man in a simple ancient stone house at night. Soft shadows, tender and peaceful mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

pro-10-19.prompt: Morning at a stone village well in ancient Israel. Several women with clay water jars talk animatedly, while one young woman listens quietly with a calm smile. Golden morning light, olive trees, stone houses on a hillside. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

mat-5-16.prompt: Inside a small one-room stone house in first-century Galilee at night. A clay oil lamp burns on a tall wooden lampstand in the middle of the room, and its warm light fills the whole house. A Middle Eastern family, a mother, a father, a grandmother and three children, sits on woven mats on the floor sharing bread, olives and lentils. Plain linen and wool clothing, clay jars, a woven basket upside down on the floor. Warm golden glow, deep blue shadows, cozy and peaceful.

psa-34-19.prompt: A young shepherd man in a simple tunic sits at the mouth of a rocky cave in the wilderness at dawn, tired but safe, looking out at the first light over the hills. Dust on his cloak, a wooden staff beside him. Quiet, hopeful mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

isa-30-18.prompt: A lone watchman stands on top of an ancient stone city wall at dawn, looking out over misty hills as the first sunlight breaks through the clouds. Pale blue and gold light, calm and expectant mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

pro-11-2.prompt: In a sunlit potter’s workshop in an ancient village, an old potter with a white beard guides the hands of a young apprentice at a spinning clay wheel. Shelves of clay jars, dust in the light beams, warm and calm. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

rom-12-18.prompt: Two neighbors meet at a low stone wall between their houses in an ancient village at golden hour. One offers a basket of figs across the wall, the other hesitates, then reaches out. Warm light, olive trees, soft and hopeful mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

psa-37-4.prompt: An old shepherd with a white beard sits peacefully on a grassy hillside at sunset, his sheep grazing around him, looking out over a wide valley glowing gold. Calm, content mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

rom-8-18.prompt: A long road winding through a dark valley at dawn, with golden sunlight flooding over the far mountains and starting to fill the valley. A lone traveler with a walking staff on the road, seen from behind. Hopeful, cinematic mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

psa-32-8.prompt: A father stands on a riverbank watching closely as his young child crosses a shallow stream on stepping stones in a green valley, morning light, the child glancing back at him. Gentle, safe mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

pro-11-13.prompt: Two friends sit close together talking quietly on the flat rooftop of a stone house in an ancient town at dusk, a small oil lamp between them, the town’s rooftops and a deep blue evening sky behind. Intimate, calm mood. The people are Middle Eastern, in plain first-century linen and wool clothing.

pro-10-25.prompt: A small ancient stone house with a flat roof stands firm on a rocky hilltop in the green hill country of ancient Israel, just after a violent storm. Massive dark storm clouds and a faint distant dust whirlwind are moving away to the right, rain still falling far off. Warm golden sunlight breaks through the clouds from the upper left and lights the house and an old twisted olive tree beside it. A dirt path winds up the hill. Broken branches and scattered straw lie on the wet grass in the foreground. Calm, hopeful mood after the storm. No people.
